# Avatar props

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | — | Image URL. The image shows once it loads; until then, or if it fails, the initials show. |
| `alt` | `string` | — | The avatar's accessible name: the image's alt text, or the label of the initials while there is no image to show. Also used to generate the fallback initials. |
| `fallback` | `ReactNode` | — | Explicit fallback displayed while there is no image to show: no `src`, or the image is loading or failed to load (overrides auto-generated initials). |
| `size` | `number` | `40` | Avatar dimensions in pixels. |
| `shape` | `"circle" \| "rounded" \| "square"` | `"circle"` | Avatar shape. |
